title: Low-Twist Matrix Covariants of Exterior Powers: Vanishing and Modular Phenomena
summary: We study morphisms from symmetric powers of exterior powers to determinant-twisted endomorphism representations of general linear groups. At the minimal positive determinant twist, we prove vanishing over every field of characteristic different from two: if the exterior degree r >= 3 is odd, the symmetric degree satisfies d >= 3, and the underlying space has dimension rd, then the corresponding equivariant Hom space is zero.
